whoItsFor: Students, self-learners, and educators who want a tutor that adapts to their own study materials and history over time. It also suits teams that want a configurable AI tutoring platform they can host themselves.
useCases: Asking questions and getting answers grounded in your own documents and knowledge bases
Turning source material into books, courses, quizzes, and question-bank practice
Reading PDFs and EPUBs alongside the tutor, with page-cited answers
